items.title: Matters.AI Lands India’s Largest Cybersecurity Pre-Series A Round to Fight AI Data Risks
items.description: The security startup consolidates four legacy security tools into an autonomous platform that uses context-aware AI to trace sensitive data lineage, analyze user intent, and automatically remediate threats across enterprise environments.

items.title: 'God Mode' Flaws Could Wreak Border-Control Havoc
items.description: Attackers could have disrupted traveler entry into Nigeria, Ethiopia, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Fiji, and Ghana via several vulnerabilities in their online visa and immigration systems.

items.title: Cyprus Becomes Espionage Target for Iranian Hackers
items.description: A previously undocumented Iranian threat group called "Volant Manticore" is targeting Cypriot organizations as part of an intelligence-gathering effort for Tehran.

items.title: Attackers Target .NET Developers With Poisoned Job Assessments
items.description: Researchers discovered 13 malicious NuGet packages as part of a fake recruitment campaign that spreads malware and gives attackers access to developers' machines.

items.title: It's a Bot World. We're Just Living in It
items.description: Bot detection has become a losing game. Security teams need to limit privileged access for humans and their machine counterparts equally.

items.title: Cyber Insurers See New Divide: AI Defense 'Haves' & 'Have Nots'
items.description: Dark Reading Confidential Episode 23: Cyber insurers share their view of the AI-driven threat landscape and how mounting challenges are putting pressure on both sides of the policy, leaving the current model unsustainable.

items.title: Latin America Sees Cyberattacks on Ports, Pipelines & Manufacturing
items.description: From the Port of Santos in Brazil to a pipeline in Argentina, cyberattacks are increasingly affecting industrial systems throughout the region.

items.title: Satellites Have a Ground-Level Cybersecurity Problem
items.description: Weaknesses in the ground-based infrastructure supporting satellite services are becoming more consequential as a new space race gathers pace.

items.title: Webworm APT Slithers Into Networks With Customized SoftEther VPN
items.description: The China-aligned espionage group rebuilt the open source VPN software from source, stripping out the artifacts that would normally expose it to defenders.

items.title: How Southeastern University Got a Handle on Its Data
items.description: Data security posture management (DSPM) allowed the university to uncover sensitive information, tighten access controls, and lay the groundwork for safer AI adoption.

items.title: Industrial Serial Gateways Broadcast That They're Insecure
items.description: Critical OT access devices will often tell you, and anyone else, whether they're protected by authentication — and many aren't.

items.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
items.description: CrowdStrike's $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler would unite endpoint protection and zero-trust network security to obtain greater control over AI agents.

items.title: US Cyber Director Pick Signals Shift Toward Expertise
items.description: Trump named Kirsten Davies as Acting National Cyber Director, bringing greater industry experience to the role amid recent outages and rising geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Behind the Alias: How One Researcher Unmasked a Decade of Ransomware Actors
items.description: Ransomware isn't slowing down. A new framework gives security teams the edge to trace attackers back to their source.

items.title: AI Agents Zip From Flaw Discovery to Root Access in 11 Minutes
items.description: A China-nexus actor used the Cairn penetration testing tool in attacks against East Asian universities, exploiting a zero-day in a medical imaging app.

items.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
items.description: Identity, runtime, and development controls are converging as enterprises look for ways to keep agents within their assigned jobs. But vendors' approaches vary, so CISOs face a choice.

items.title: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
items.description: During the last wave of major VMware vCenter security updates, a China-nexus threat group likely already had its next zero-day up its sleeve.

items.title: Nok et norsk energiselskap har blitt utsatt for et datainnbrudd på to dager
items.description: Det er ikke påvist noen konkret sammenheng mellom de to hendelsene, selv om de helt klart har mange likhetstrekk.

items.title: In Security, Words Matter as Much as Tools — Maybe More
items.description: From talking cloud security to using AI, cyber leaders are finding that clear, disciplined communication is now a front-line defense capability across the enterprise.

items.title: What We Missed: Nvidia CEO Scandal Rocks AI Industry
items.description: In this video, Dark Reading editors discuss some of the news they didn't get a chance to cover, from Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia to Microsoft's recent cloud outage.
